about: Synthetic labelled conversations for fitting the salience gate (evals/gate.py). Made up; no real people. Each line: [day offset, speaker, text, label, what memory should hold]. Speaker 'user' = the user (trust 2), a teammate's name = trust 1, 'app ...' = outside content (trust 0). keep = will matter later; maybe = small or unsure; skip = nothing lasting.
